methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
This paper provides a methodology to assess the maturity of an organization’s readiness for change 
based on the use of a Fuzzy Analytic Network Process and fuzzy linguistic evaluation maturity model

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a readiness-for-change maturity model (organisational assessment via Fuzzy Analytic Network Process and fuzzy linguistic evaluation); contains no EnPI/EnB measurement-model content. ISO 50001/EnMS is only the change context - no energy performance indicator or energy baseline is defined, estimated, or characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote: Development of a readiness for change maturity model

stage1.notes: Model measures organisational readiness (change-management factors), not energy performance. Case is an automotive assembly plant (discrete manufacturing), outside continuous-process Corpus-B scope.
